caption: The drawing depicts a cart being pulled by two black goats with red and yellow bridles and red saddle blankets. The goats are harnessed side by side, connected by black straps to the cart. The cart itself has four large wooden wheels and is decorated with blue, red, and yellow elements. The cart features a covered top, which is shaded in black, with supporting posts painted yellow and red. There are horizontal guard rails on the sides, painted blue and red. Inside the cart, a person with a brown shirt, white pants, and a cap is seated, facing forward and holding the reins. The background is plain and off-white, with no additional objects or scenery. In the lower left corner, the artist's name, "Elmer Weiser," is inscribed in blue.
title: Toy Goat Cart
